## Checklist

- [ ] `xcodegen generate` succeeds and the app builds
- [ ] `swiftlint lint --strict` is clean
- [ ] `swiftformat Verdant VerdantTests` produces no changes
- [ ] Tests pass; new logic has tests
- [ ] No diagnostic/prescriptive language added to user-facing copy or model prompts
- [ ] No health values logged or committed; `Domain/` stays framework-free
